name: @plebeian-apps/dm
description: The dm module's first implementation (TypeScript): the small DM component that owns NIP-17/59 writes and reads over applesauce-common's gift-wrap primitives (sealRumor + wrapSeal for the write, unlockGiftWrap for the read) and resolves its relay targets from the relay-config port (kind 10050, no fallback to 10002).
